findings.reason: it would add a seventh cite-or-justify ruling naming forward.py:1292 and resolve whether forward.py's moment-map methods are carried, re-pointed or deleted, the same decision the plan already makes explicitly for every sibling helper.
findings.text: §4 directs `gs.apply` to carry "the moment-map derivative" into the new module, but forward.py already owns that machinery: `current_moment_jacobian` (forward.py:1292) differentiates the support-declared current-moment map, with `current_moment_map` (1276) and `current_moment_observation` (1239) beside it, and forward.py is itself retained as the request/receipt adapter; unlike the GMRES kernel, the field-null kernels, the geometry operands, the quadrature helpers and the contour tree — each given an explicit cite-or-justify ruling — this carried derivative has no owner named, so an implementer may fork it into gs.py while forward.py's copy survives, which the plan's own import census would not catch for a derivative rather than a module

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — `topology.read`, `current.book`, `gs.apply` and `solve.fixed_point` each collapse a multi-file subsystem (17 null authorities and 23 region authorities for the read; contour tree, clip quadrature, coupling matrix and Newton-GMRES for the rest) behind one call each, so complexity is concentrated rather than spread.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — `gs.apply` is to carry the moment-map derivative but the plan names no owner for it, while forward.py already differentiates the support-declared current-moment map over flux.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §2 names Topology.read/read_with_connectivity, §3 names clipped_support_current_moments and the forward_operator support partition, §4 names the ForwardFluxOperator map, §5 names newton_krylov/picard/operator_request_body, and §6 names the ladder, frozen/live split, live-read and active-set routes as retirements.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan cites prior art for the GMRES kernel (`_single_site_krylov` et al. in fixed_point.py), the field-null kernels (nova/biot/null.py, fieldnull.py), the contour tree (contour_tree.py / contour_tree_mesh.py), the moment owner (polygon_moments.py), the geometry-operand flatteners (forward_operator.py) and the quadrature helpers (clip_quadrature.py), and every named symbol was verified present in the code.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the plan states `gs.apply` "replaces the map ForwardFluxOperator performs today rather than wrapping it", `topology.read` replaces the old read in place, and the retained `ForwardProfile.operator` seam is justified as forward.py's request/receipt adapter for duck-typed consumers being re-pointed off the deleted class.
